006package dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter;
007
008import org.apache.commons.codec.BinaryDecoder;
009import org.apache.commons.codec.BinaryEncoder;
010import org.apache.commons.codec.binary.Hex;
011
012import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
013import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
014import java.util.List;
015
016import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
017import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IHexBinaryItem;
018import dev.metaschema.core.qname.EQNameFactory;
019import dev.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
020import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
021import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
022
023/**
024 * Maintains a byte buffer backed representation of a byte stream parsed from a
025 * base64 encoded string.
026 * <p>
027 * Provides support for the Metaschema <a href=
028 * "https://pages.nist.gov/metaschema/specification/datatypes/#base64">base64</a>
029 * data type.
030 */
031public class HexBinaryAdapter
032    extends AbstractBinaryAdapter<IHexBinaryItem> {
033  @NonNull
034  private static final List<IEnhancedQName> NAMES = ObjectUtils.notNull(List.of(
035      EQNameFactory.instance().newQName(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH, "hex-binary")));
036
037  @NonNull
038  private static final Hex HEX = new Hex(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
039
040  HexBinaryAdapter() {
041    super(IHexBinaryItem.class, IHexBinaryItem::cast);
042  }
043
044  @Override
045  protected BinaryEncoder getEncoder() {
046    return HEX;
047  }
048
049  @Override
050  protected BinaryDecoder getDecoder() {
051    return HEX;
052  }
053
054  @Override
055  public List<IEnhancedQName> getNames() {
056    return NAMES;
057  }
058
059  @Override
060  public IHexBinaryItem newItem(Object value) {
061    ByteBuffer item = toValue(value);
062    return IHexBinaryItem.valueOf(item);
063  }
064}
